name: Two-link narrow passage
description: A 2-DOF arm must swing from the right side to the left side past a vertical wall above its base. Straight-ish arms hit the wall; the only ways past are to fold the forearm almost to its joint limit. In the C-space view these are thin channels squeezed between the forbidden band and the joint limits: random samples rarely land in them, which is the classic narrow-passage problem for sampling-based planners.
